_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'delvers_hill' (Delvers' Hill). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

foreman_hollis.name: Foreman Hollis
foreman_hollis.greeting: Mine's open, seams are rich, and everyone's terrified. Normal week.

lampwoman_gwen.name: Gwen Lampwright
lampwoman_gwen.greeting: Lamps! Oil! Candles! Everything you need to see what's eating you.

sergeant_cadoc.name: Sergeant Brask
sergeant_cadoc.greeting: Headframe fort. Holds the hill. Also holds the lift, which is broken.

old_miner_pike.name: Old Pike
old_miner_pike.greeting: Down the well's quicker than the shaft, if you don't mind the rats.

angler_copperdell.name: Dunmer Slagfoot
angler_copperdell.greeting: Twelve hours underground, then I come up here and stare at water. Do not talk to me about ore. See the ripples, just south-west of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

quests.name: Copper and Candles
quests.offer: Orla in Ashcombe vouched for you. My seam's full of beetles that eat copper and then try to eat miners. Clear the upper galleries.

steps.text: Kill 6 ironback beetles in the galleries
Collect 4 copper nuggets from ironback beetles
steps.where: ironback beetles in the upper galleries

quests.done: Copper back, beetles gone. Head down to Brackwater, the reeve there sent for help.

quests.name: Lamp Oil
quests.offer: Ash wisps keep stealing the flame out of my lamps. I need their sparks for new wicks. Don't ask how. Wick-making is a dark art.

steps.text: Collect 5 wisp sparks from ash wisps
steps.where: ash wisps in the old workings of Delvers' Hill

quests.done: Lovely bright ones. Lamps for everybody. Mind your eyebrows.

quests.name: Rats in the Lift
quests.offer: The lift's broken because rats chewed the rope. The rope's broken because rats. Everything's broken because rats.

steps.where: the lift house by the Old Headframe Fort
steps.text: Kill 10 cairn rats at the lift house

quests.done: Right. New rope. New rats probably. But not today.

quests.name: Down the Well
quests.offer: Old cache down the dry well, put there by my grandad. Rats are sat on it. Go fetch it, keep a coin for yourself.

steps.where: The Dry Well, out on Delvers' Hill

quests.done: Grandad's pipe! And his teeth. Don't ask why he kept his teeth.

quests.name: The Deep Seam
quests.offer: The deep seam has a shift that never clocks off. Something down there is still working. Go and give it notice.

steps.text: Reach the deep seam of Old Copperdeep
steps.where: Old Copperdeep, the dungeon door on Delvers' Hill

quests.done: Silence below. First quiet night in Copperdell in ten years.

quests.name: The Hill's Bad Neighbour
quests.offer: Big one roaming the spoil heaps. Kill it before it decides the fort looks tasty.

steps.where: roams the spoil heaps of Delvers' Hill

quests.done: That's one fewer thing trying to eat my fort.
